title: GLB/glTF loading into the mesh pipeline
description: Bridge Assimp into the geometry pipeline so the ten Trellis2 scans in ~/crawfish (IMG_4109..IMG_4118.glb, one mesh each, ~623k vertices / ~936k triangles, POSITION+NORMAL+TEXCOORD_0, one PBR material, two embedded PNGs) load as HalfEdgeMesh/ArrayMesh geometry. Today MeshLoader.load dispatches only .obj/.ply/.off to parsers that emit ArrayMesh, while AssimpModelImporter (graphics/render/model) already reads GLB via lwjgl-assimp but emits GPU-interleaved floats and is reachable only from ModelLoadScene. Add a GltfMeshParser in geometry/mesh/data/load that calls Assimp.aiImportFile (aiProcess_Triangulate | aiProcess_JoinIdenticalVertices) and produces the same ArrayMesh shape as ObjMeshParser, carrying TEXCOORD_0 as a per-vertex GeometryBundle slot whose name constant lives on the parser (the material/texture bytes are CRAW-3's job). Register .glb/.gltf in MeshLoader.load, LoadMeshNode.socketDocs, ModelCatalog (staging scan and a plain directory scan) and ixdar-cli list-meshes. Loading must go through the Platform abstraction where it touches native buffers (IxBuffer, not org.lwjgl.BufferUtils). Desktop-only: the web build must not reach Assimp. Related: VIEW-6 (model staging directory + sync-models) is the catalog this extends.
definition-of-done: 1. MeshLoader.load("~/crawfish/IMG_4109.glb") returns an ArrayMesh with 622652 vertices and 936035 triangles and a UV slot of matching length. 2. `load_mesh(path="...glb")` works in a .dsl graph and mesh-viewer shows the crawfish via `uv run ixdar-cli run-scene --scene mesh-viewer --property ixdar.model=<path>`. 3. `ixdar-cli list-meshes` lists .glb files found in $IXDAR_MODEL_DIR and ~/crawfish when pointed at it. 4. Peak heap while loading one scan stays under 2 GB (no per-vertex boxing; direct buffers reused). 5. The TeaVM build (`./tools/teavm-build.sh`) still succeeds with no Assimp symbols in classes.js. 6. `mvn -q clean compile -pl annotations,ixdar-app` is checkstyle-green and all existing mesh tests pass.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test GltfMeshParserTest with a tiny hand-written .gltf (two triangles, UVs) under test resources -- asserts positions, indices, UV slot. 2. Benchmark in ixdar-app/test/benchmark/ that loads one crawfish scan and prints vertex/face counts and elapsed ms. 3. run-scene screenshot of mesh-viewer with the scan; compare against `ixdar-cli mesh-state` counts. 4. Confirm MeshLoader still rejects unknown extensions with the existing IllegalArgumentException message.

LoadMeshNode.class carries an orphan constant-pool Class entry for GltfMeshParser (from reading the inlined UV_SLOT constant in socketDocs). No instruction references it and TeaVM walks method bodies, so it should create no dependency edge -- but this could not be confirmed against a real classes.js. If it ever trips TeaVM, move UV_SLOT onto LoadMeshNode.

ModelCatalog.staging() now silently degrades to a plain directory scan when the root has neither dsl/ nor obj/. That is what makes IXDAR_MODEL_DIR=~/crawfish work without sync-models, but a typo-ed staging root now scans as a plain directory instead of coming back empty.
changes-made: Added GltfMeshParser (geometry/mesh/data/load): Assimp aiImportFile with aiProcess_Triangulate only -- JoinIdenticalVertices is deliberately off so the vertex count still matches the glTF accessors and seam UVs survive. Two passes over the node tree size then bulk-copy the tightly packed Assimp streams into flat float[]/int[] arrays via MemoryUtil.memFloatBuffer(...).get(array, offset, count), baking each node world transform in place; nothing is boxed.

TEXCOORD_0 rides the bundle as GltfMeshParser.UV_SLOT = "_uv", a Vector3Field of (u, v, 0) with one element per vertex (REFACTOR-PLAN-2 C6 prefers the Field forms). Assimp delivers glTF UVs flipped to the OpenGL bottom-left origin, so the slot holds 1 - v_gltf; the unit test asserts that convention rather than silently correcting it, so CRAW-3 knows what it is getting.

MeshLoader: .glb/.gltf registered; new loadBundle(String) returns a GeometryBundle so attribute slots survive while load(String) keeps its ArrayMesh signature; added isSupported/isGltf/MESH_EXTENSIONS. The parser is reached by Class.forName so there is no compiled edge from MeshLoader to Assimp and the web build refuses the load with a clear IOException.
LoadMeshNode now calls loadBundle so _uv reaches the graph; description() and socketDocs() document .glb/.gltf and the slot (mesh-node-catalog.json regenerated).

ModelCatalog gained directory(Path), a plain recursive scan accepting every extension MeshLoader reads; staging(Path) falls back to it when the root has neither dsl/ nor obj/, and otherwise also collects .glb/.gltf below the root. IXDAR_MODEL_DIR=~/crawfish therefore surfaces all ten scans with no sync-models run.

MeshNodeViewerScene honours -Dixdar.model in mesh-viewer: a catalog token when one resolves, otherwise the property taken as a mesh path. loadObjFromAbsolutePath renamed loadMeshFileFromAbsolutePath since it is no longer OBJ-only.

mesh_catalog.py: mesh_roots() adds IXDAR_MODEL_DIR, MESH_EXTENSIONS gained .ply/.glb/.gltf, and _gltf_counts reads vertex/triangle counts from the glTF JSON (or the GLB JSON chunk) alone, so a 40 MB scan costs a few hundred kB of I/O.

NOT MET DoD 5: ./tools/teavm-build.sh cannot run on this machine, for two pre-existing reasons proven independent of this branch. (a) The script builds -pl ixdar-app alone, so annotations resolves from ~/.m2, where the jar is dated 2026-08-16 and predates MeshNodeAnnotation.desktopOnly(); fix is `mvn install -pl annotations` once, not done because it writes shared ~/.m2 while other agents build. (b) With annotations in the reactor, TeaVM 0.15 dies with "Unsupported class file major version 71". Nothing on the plugin-reported TeaVM classpath exceeds major 69 (scanned every class in all 60 jars and both target/classes); re-running under JAVA_HOME=java-26-openjdk changes the message to major 70, so the number tracks the JDK running Maven, not our code. TeaVM 0.15 bundles ASM 9.8 (ceiling Java 25 = 69) and this machine has only JDK 26 and mise JDK 27. The last successful classes.js is dated 2026-08-16 20:12, the same day as the stale jar -- the toolchain broke when the JDK moved past 25, long before this branch.

DoD 5 second clause checked statically since no classes.js could be produced: GltfMeshParser is reached only via Class.forName, so no TeaVM-visible class has a call edge to Assimp. Disclosed caveat: javap shows an orphan constant-pool entry "#36 = Class .../GltfMeshParser" in LoadMeshNode.class, emitted because socketDocs() reads the compile-time constant UV_SLOT; no instruction or attribute references it (the "_uv" string is inlined) and TeaVM walks method bodies, not raw constant pools, so it creates no dependency edge. Moving UV_SLOT onto LoadMeshNode would remove it if it ever bites.
